# openaiagents_agent (Resource)

A reusable saved agent in the hosted OpenAI Agents API (`POST /v1/agents`). Credentials are not stored on the agent; MCP authentication uses vault credential references. This resource never creates sessions or runs turns.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openaiagents_agent" "minimal" {
  model        = "gpt-6-astra"
  name         = "support"
  instructions = "Answer clearly and concisely."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `model` (String) Model name as supplied. The requested name is preserved; this provider does not rewrite it.

### Optional

- `instructions` (String) Custom instructions appended to the agent default. Removing this attribute sends JSON null so the API clears it.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Up to 16 string key-value pairs. Removing keys or the map sends an empty object so the API clears them.
- `multi_agent` (Attributes) Subagent configuration. Removing the block sends JSON null so multi-agent behavior is disabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--multi_agent))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name. Removing this attribute sends JSON null so the API clears it.
- `reasoning` (Attributes) Reasoning configuration. Removing the block sends JSON null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reasoning))
- `service_tier` (String) Service tier: `auto`, `default`, `flex`, `priority`, or `fast`. Defaults to the API value `auto`.
- `text` (Attributes) Text output configuration. Removing the block sends JSON null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--text))
- `tools` (Attributes List) Persisted tool union. Supported types: `function`, `tool_search`, `programmatic_tool_calling`, `mcp`, `web_search`. Unsupported types are rejected. MCP inline authorization is rejected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the agent was created.
- `id` (String) Remote agent ID.
- `object` (String) Object type. Always `agent`.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the agent was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--multi_agent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `multi_agent`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether subagent tools are enabled.

Optional:

- `max_concurrent_subagents` (Number) Maximum concurrent subagents. Defaults to 6 when enabled.


<a id="nestedatt--reasoning"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reasoning`

Optional:

- `effort` (String) Reasoning effort: `none`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, or `max`.
- `summary` (String) Reasoning summary: `concise`, `detailed`, or `auto`.


<a id="nestedatt--text"></a>
### Nested Schema for `text`

Optional:

- `format` (Attributes) Output format. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--text--format))
- `verbosity` (String) Text verbosity: `low`, `medium`, or `high`.

<a id="nestedatt--text--format"></a>
### Nested Schema for `text.format`

Required:

- `type` (String) `text` or `json_schema`.

Optional:

- `schema_json` (String) JSON Schema object as a JSON string. Required when `type` is `json_schema`. Nested keywords and booleans such as `additionalProperties: false` are preserved.



<a id="nestedatt--tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools`

Required:

- `type` (String) Tool type.

Optional:

- `function` (Attributes) Function tool. Required when `type` is `function`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools--function))
- `mcp` (Attributes) Credential-free MCP server. Required when `type` is `mcp`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools--mcp))
- `programmatic_tool_calling` (Attributes) Programmatic tool calling. Used when `type` is `programmatic_tool_calling`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools--programmatic_tool_calling))
- `web_search` (Attributes) Web search tool. Used when `type` is `web_search`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools--web_search))

<a id="nestedatt--tools--function"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools.function`

Required:

- `description` (String) Function description.
- `name` (String) Function name.
- `parameters_json` (String) JSON Schema for function arguments as a JSON string.

Optional:

- `defer_loading` (Boolean) Whether the function is deferred and discovered through tool search. Defaults to false.


<a id="nestedatt--tools--mcp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools.mcp`

Required:

- `server_label` (String) Label used to identify the MCP server in tool calls.
- `transport` (Attributes) Credential-free transport. HTTP `authorization` and credential-bearing headers are rejected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools--mcp--transport))

Optional:

- `allowed_tools` (List of String) MCP tools the agent may call. Omitted means all tools are allowed; an empty list allows none.
- `connection_origin` (String) `service` (OpenAI network) or `environment` (session environment).
- `credential_id` (String) Vault credential selected for this MCP server.
- `request_metadata_json` (String) Metadata included with requests to this MCP server, as a JSON object string.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether this MCP server must initialize before the first turn. Defaults to false.

<a id="nestedatt--tools--mcp--transport"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools.mcp.transport`

Required:

- `type` (String) `http` or `stdio`.

Optional:

- `args` (List of String) Arguments passed to a stdio MCP server command.
- `command` (String) Command used to start a stdio MCP server.
- `cwd` (String) Working directory for a stdio MCP server.
- `env_vars` (List of String) Environment variable names inherited from the execution environment.
- `headers` (Map of String) Non-secret HTTP headers.
- `server_url` (String) MCP server URL. Required for `http`.



<a id="nestedatt--tools--programmatic_tool_calling"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools.programmatic_tool_calling`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether tools can be called from model-generated code. Defaults to true.


<a id="nestedatt--tools--web_search"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools.web_search`

Optional:

- `allowed_domains` (List of String) Domains the search may include.
- `context_size` (String) `low`, `medium`, or `high`. Defaults to the hosted API value `medium` (verified 2026-09-11).
- `location` (Attributes) Approximate user location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools--web_search--location))
- `mode` (String) `disabled`, `cached`, or `live`. Defaults to the hosted API value `live` (verified 2026-09-11).

<a id="nestedatt--tools--web_search--location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools.web_search.location`

Optional:

- `city` (String) City name.
- `country` (String) Two-letter ISO country code.
- `region` (String) Region or state name.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import openaiagents_agent.minimal agent_abc123
```
